note: External coverage of the May-October 2024 R-LNG shortfall around Cyclone Remal. These are REPORTING, not measurements: nothing here is plotted, summed or compared with an archive figure. `reportsOn` is the date the item is about, established from the item's own text, and `dateBasis` says how. An item whose page refused retrieval is listed with reportsOn null: its headline and URL come from a search listing, its text was not read, and it is shown outside the day-by-day timeline rather than placed on a day nothing established.
method: WebSearch for the Summit FSRU damage in Cyclone Remal, its repair and return, and the July 2024 re-mooring; each placed item was then fetched and its date read from its own text. The Daily Star, The Business Standard and The Financial Express answered 403 to automated retrieval.

items.headline: Cyclone Remal
items.dateBasis: States the cyclone reached peak intensity on the afternoon of 26 May 2024 as it began making landfall on Bangladesh, near Mongla. PGCB's own outage log first names Cyclone Remal on energy day 26 May, at 04:01.

items.headline: Cyclone damages Excelerate's FSRU in Bangladesh
items.dateBasis: Published 3 June 2024. States the FSRU Summit LNG was struck by a floating object during cyclone Remal on 27 May 2024 at approximately 20:10 local time.

items.headline: Excelerate Energy LNG FSRU damaged by cyclone
items.dateBasis: Published 12 June 2024. States the vessel was struck on 27 May 2024 offshore Moheshkhali, with water ingress into the ballast tanks.

items.headline: Cyclone Remal snuffs out Bangladesh LNG operations
items.dateBasis: Published 13 July 2024. States regasification at the two FSRUs was slowed to around 320 MMcf/d just before the cyclone, raised back to around 1.0 Bcf/d by 29 May, and fell back to 600 MMcf/d on 30 May after the damage to the Summit FSRU was identified.

items.headline: Excelerate says Bangladesh FSRU to resume ops by end of July
items.dateBasis: Published 14 June 2024. States the vessel disconnected from the terminal on 12 June 2024 to sail to a shipyard in Southeast Asia.

items.headline: Summit LNG Terminal is Ready for Gas Supply to the National Grid
items.dateBasis: The terminal operator's own statement, dated 11 September 2024: ready to send out 500 MMcfd.

items.headline: Summit says Bangladesh FSRU ready to resume ops
items.dateBasis: Publication date, 12 September 2024. The body past its opening paragraph is paywalled and was not read.

items.headline: Gas supply falls as Remal damages Summit FSRU
items.dateBasis: Not established. The page refused automated retrieval on 2026-09-13, so neither its date nor its text was read.
